title: 第23章 花园种植
novel_title: 我在星际召唤古人，带飞华夏文明
content_zh:
花期穿上第一套缝纫的廉价齐胸襦裙，随便将头发挽成低马尾，插了两三颗珍珠在发尾间，便拿着一口袋花种子跑去花园。

    昨天光顾着装修甜品店，都没来得及查看花园。

    如今花园解锁，古城唯二的两块种植地都被一起点亮。

    花园就在种植区对面，不过花期昨天没来，花园还是呈现灰色状态。

    像是一块地区被围墙笼罩，外人看不到里头的景象。

    花期一走进，笼罩的围墙慢慢散去，露出了花园的真面目。

    地面是呈梯形状的格子土地，路面铺着青石板，中间有一块圆形区域，泥土格子里拥有高矮不一的假山石。

    说是花园，其实只能算得上园，因为这里一朵花都没有。

    相比种植区还有野草，这里完全光秃秃的，除了石头便是泥土。

    造型也比较诡异，从地图上看，花园整体区域是圆形的，就像现代餐桌的圆盘。

    周边被分开的格子很像围绕圆桌的长形盘子，中间的圆形区域则是放置汤盘的地方。

    空余的地方贴了青石板，每一个格子之间都有一条行走的路。

    花期沿着青石板走来，随便停在一处有两块大石头的泥土格子前。

    她盯着这块格子看了许久，脑中简单勾勒出一个设计方案。

    和种植区一样，每个格子种下一种花，利用花朵的习性，将花墙种起来。

    反正花园也有将近八亩地，上百种花卉和树木种下去，还省了她人工规划地盘。

    花期拿出三角梅的种子，交给自动播种的机械鸟。

    她本来不想买机械鸟，准备等明天松松和荣华回来一起播种。

    但现在拥有了云纱，她又有新的任务交给荣华。

    昨日种植的水果也挂果了，松松明天也要去摘果子，任务多时间紧，只好又买了一个播种鸟。

    鸟儿体型比机械鼠大一点，和无人机差不多，背部存放种子，腹部丢种子，身体的孔洞自动喷水。

    它围着一块两百平米的格子飞了一圈，将三角梅的所有种子均匀洒在土里，还特意在石头附近多洒了一些。

    剩下的种子也是如此，对于适合爬杆生长的花卉，播种鸟会特意找有石头的格子，将它们种在一起。

    她还利用地图的移动功能，调整了格子的距离，尽量将同种类花卉安排在一块儿。

    那些不适合爬杆、只适合在土里生长的花卉，比如玫瑰、月季等，则被集中在另一处。

    还有樱花、桃花、梅花、腊梅等大型花树，被集中在矮花卉对面，留出充足的空间适合拍照。

    一个圆形花园，总共被分为四块区域。
content_en:
During the flowering period, I put on my first cheap chest-length skirt that I had sewn, casually pulled my hair into a low ponytail, inserted two or three pearls between the ends of my hair, and ran to the garden with a bag of flower seeds.

    Yesterday, I patronized the dessert shop for renovation and didn't even have time to check out the garden.

    Now that the garden is unlocked, the only two planting areas in the ancient city are lit up together.

    The garden is opposite the planting area, but the flowering period did not come yesterday, so the garden is still in a gray state.

    It's like an area is surrounded by a wall, and outsiders can't see what's going on inside.

    As soon as you walk in during the flowering period, the shrouded wall slowly dissipates, revealing the true face of the garden.

    The ground is a trapezoidal grid. The road is paved with bluestone slabs. There is a circular area in the middle. There are rockery stones of different heights in the soil grid.

    It is said to be a garden, but in fact it can only be regarded as a garden, because there are not a single flower here.

    Compared to the planting area where there are still weeds, this place is completely bare, with only rocks and soil.

    The shape is also quite strange. From the map, the overall garden area is circular, just like the disc of a modern dining table.

    The divided grid on the periphery is like a long plate surrounding a round table, and the circular area in the middle is where the soup plate is placed.

    Bluestone slabs have been pasted in the spare areas, and there is a walking path between each grid.

    Hua Shi walked along the bluestone slabs and stopped in front of a dirt grid with two big stones.

    She stared at the grid for a long time and briefly sketched a design plan in her mind.

    Just like the planting area, one kind of flower is planted in each grid, and the flower wall is planted using the habits of the flowers.

    Anyway, the garden has nearly eight acres of land, with hundreds of flowers and trees planted, and it saves her manual planning of the land.

    During the flowering period, take out the bougainvillea seeds and give them to the mechanical bird that automatically sows them.

    She originally didn't want to buy a mechanical bird, and planned to wait until Songsong and Ronghua came back tomorrow to sow seeds together.

    But now that she has Yunsha, she has a new task for Ronghua.

    The fruits planted yesterday have also begun to bear fruit. Songsong is going to pick fruits tomorrow. She has many tasks and is short on time, so she had to buy another sowing bird.

    The bird is a little larger than a mechanical mouse and similar to a drone. It stores seeds on its back, throws them on its belly, and automatically sprays water through the holes in its body.

    It flew around a two-hundred-square-meter grid and evenly sprinkled all the bougainvillea seeds in the soil, and even sprinkled more seeds near the stones.

    The same is true for the remaining seeds. For flowers suitable for climbing poles, the sowing birds will deliberately find a grid with stones and plant them together.

    She also used the map's moving function to adjust the distance between the grids and try to arrange flowers of the same type together.

    Those flowers that are not suitable for climbing poles and are only suitable for growing in the soil, such as roses and roses, are concentrated in another place.

    There are also large flowering trees such as cherry blossoms, peach blossoms, plum blossoms, and wintersweets, which are concentrated opposite the dwarf flowers, leaving ample space for taking pictures.

    A circular garden is divided into four areas.
